tools.name: file_new
tools.description: New. Replace the document with an empty net.

tools.name: file_export_json
tools.description: Export JSON. The document as pflow.xyz JSON-LD (unbounded capacities as null).

tools.name: file_cid
tools.description: Compute CID. The CID the document seals to (the same as /api/save and pflow-native file.cid).

tools.name: edit_undo
tools.description: Undo. Undo the last edit.

tools.name: edit_redo
tools.description: Redo. Redo the last undone edit.

tools.name: edit_delete
tools.description: Delete. Delete places and transitions, with every arc that touches them.

tools.name: net_info
tools.description: Net info. Counts, ids, labels and rates: a summary of the net.

tools.name: net_add_place
tools.description: Add place. Add a place at (x, y).

id.description: id (default: the first free p0, p1, …)

tools.name: net_add_transition
tools.description: Add transition. Add a transition at (x, y).

id.description: id (default: the first free t0, t1, …)

tools.name: net_add_arc
tools.description: Add arc. Add an arc between a place and a transition. inhibit on place→transition is an inhibitor arc; on transition→place it is a read arc (the editor's output-side inhibit).

tools.name: net_set_arc
tools.description: Set arc. Change an arc's weight or whether it inhibits.

tools.name: net_delete_arc
tools.description: Delete arc. Delete the arc(s) from source to target.

tools.name: net_set_place
tools.description: Set place. Set a place's initial marking and/or capacity (0 or null = unbounded). An initial marking over capacity is refused, not clamped.

tools.name: net_set_label
tools.description: Set label. Set a node's label (≤ 100 characters, one line).

tools.name: net_add_tokens
tools.description: Add tokens. Add (or with a negative delta, remove) tokens of one color. Refused below zero or over capacity.

tools.name: net_move
tools.description: Move node. Move a node to (x, y).

tools.name: net_rename
tools.description: Rename node. Change a node's id, updating every arc.

tools.name: net_set_details
tools.description: Edit details. Set the net's name and description (an empty string removes one).

tools.name: sim_enabled
tools.description: Enabled transitions. The transitions enabled at the current marking.

tools.name: sim_marking
tools.description: Marking. The current marking, per place, per color.

tools.name: sim_fire
tools.description: Fire. Fire one transition (the token game). Refused when it is not enabled.

tools.name: sim_reset
tools.description: Reset marking. Back to the marking the run started from.

tools.name: sim_set_rate
tools.description: Set rate. Set a transition's rate (≥ 0; 0 disables it in the ODE). Rates are part of the document.

tools.name: sim_ode
tools.description: Run ODE. Integrate the mass-action ODE from the current marking (Tsit5, the document's rates) and store a time-series artifact. The result carries initial, final and delta per place.

method.description: tsit5 (the only method in the browser; pflow-native also has rk45, rk4, euler, heun, midpoint, bs32)

tools.name: opt_rate_scan
tools.description: Rate scan. Sweep one transition's rate and record each place's value at t_end (the editor's steady-state reading, not a detected equilibrium). Stores a time-series artifact whose x axis is the rate.

method.description: tsit5 (the only method in the browser; pflow-native also has rk45, rk4, euler, heun, midpoint, bs32)

tools.name: opt_sweep
tools.description: Sweep. One place's trajectory for each of several rates of one transition, resampled onto one time grid. Stores a time-series artifact with one series per rate (group k=<rate>).

method.description: tsit5 (the only method in the browser; pflow-native also has rk45, rk4, euler, heun, midpoint, bs32)

tools.name: analysis_check
tools.description: Check net. The editor's strict check: every problem the editor would otherwise repair quietly, with a path, plus warnings. With engines (default true) and no errors, also runs the firing rule, the ODE solver's reading and CID sealing. Stores a report artifact.

strict.description: a key the editor does not write is an error (default false)

engines.description: run the engine checks too (default true)

tools.name: sim_goto
tools.description: Go to marking. Load a marking from a result onto the net: a step of a trace artifact (step), or a state of a graph artifact (node). The run baseline is kept, so Reset marking returns to where the run started.

node.description: graph node id (its data.marking is loaded)

tools.name: view_highlight
tools.description: Highlight nodes. Mark places/transitions on the canvas, optionally with a number badge each (e.g. invariant coefficients).

weights.description: {node: number} badges (pass a JSON value as a string)

tools.name: view_clear_highlight
tools.description: Clear highlight. Remove the canvas highlight.

tools.name: artifact_show_set
tools.description: Show set. Highlight one node set of a sets artifact (an invariant's support, a siphon, an orbit) on the canvas; without a view, return it.

tools.name: artifact_list
tools.description: Results. The stored artifacts, newest last: id, title, kind and the command that made each.

tools.name: artifact_get
tools.description: Get result. One artifact in full.

tools.name: view_fit
tools.description: Fit to view. Frame the whole net.

tools.name: analysis_validate
tools.description: Validate. pflow-validation's structural checks (structure, connectivity, deadlocks, unboundedness, conservation) as a table, with a summary report. `reachability` also explores the state space (up to max_states).

reachability.description: also run a bounded reachability analysis (default false)

tools.name: analysis_incidence
tools.description: Incidence Matrix. The incidence matrix C = post − pre (rows: places in document order, `place.color` per used colour on a coloured net; columns: transitions). Read and inhibitor arcs move nothing, so they do not enter it. Returns pre and post too.

tools.name: analysis_invariants
tools.description: Invariants. Minimal semi-positive P-invariants (conservation laws, valued at the current marking) and T-invariants (firing counts that return the net to its marking), by Farkas elimination. Stores one node set per invariant (show one on the net) and the basis as a matrix; reports P-coverage (covered ⇒ structurally bounded) and T-coverage.

tools.name: analysis_siphons
tools.description: Siphons & Traps. Every minimal siphon and trap, from the arc structure alone (sim_invariants' siphon/trap report). Marks each siphon empty at the current marking (a deadlock witness: the transitions needing it never fire again) and whether it contains a marked trap (Commoner's property, which certifies deadlock freedom for ordinary nets and liveness for free-choice ones). Refuses nets over 128 token places or a search over budget.

tools.name: analysis_verify
tools.description: Verify Properties. Check properties (sim_verify's JSON): deadlock-free, bounded (with bound k > 0: every place ≤ k), live, terminating, reachable/unreachable {target}, invariant {expr}, mutual-exclusion {places, bound}, conserves. Each verdict is proved / refuted / unknown with its method (structural holds for any initial marking; exhaustive for this one; partial = truncated). Every refutation with a replayable counterexample stores a trace.

properties.description: array of properties (or a JSON string of one); default bounded + deadlock-free (pass a JSON value as a string)

from_current.description: verify from the canvas marking instead of the declared initial marking

tools.name: analysis_reach
tools.description: Reach Marking. Is `to` reachable (sim_reach)? `to` constrains only the places it names, each to exactly that count. yes: a shortest firing sequence, stored as a trace; no: a P-invariant whose weighted sum separates from and to (valid whatever inhibitors, read arcs or capacities allow), or an exhaustive search; unknown: the budget ran out (not a no).

to.description: {place: n} or {place: [per color]} (null entries free); place.color names one color (pass a JSON value as a string)

from.description: sparse override on the start marking, same shape as to (pass a JSON value as a string)

from_current.description: start from the canvas marking instead of the declared initial marking

tools.name: analysis_reachability
tools.description: Reachability Graph. Explore every marking reachable from the initial (or current) marking under the token game's firing rule. When a marking strictly covers an ancestor through a pump of monotone transitions, the places that grew become ω (Karp–Miller coverability), so an unbounded net still gives a finite graph. Stores a graph (node per marking, edge per firing) and a report.

max_states.description: markings to keep, 1..20000 (default 2000); beyond it the graph is truncated

from_current.description: start from the canvas marking instead of the declared initial marking

tools.name: analysis_canonical
tools.description: Canonical Id & Orbits. An isomorphism-invariant id (equal for two nets that differ only by renaming) and the exact automorphism orbits, by individualization-refinement (a port of sim_canonical). One node set per non-trivial orbit. Refuses past a 1,000,000-step budget.

tools.name: analysis_classify
tools.description: Classify. Classes of nodes the net cannot tell apart, by colour refinement (a port of sim_classify without its sampled experiments): quantitative colour → FungibleSet candidates, settled by the exact orbits when verify is on; structural colour → Roles. One node set per class.

scope.description: "all" (places and transitions, default), "places", "transitions" or "pools" (sim's: conserved/bounded places marked initially)

verify.description: settle fungible candidates by the exact orbit search (default true)
